recipes.name: American Breakfast Casserole
ingredients_raw: 4 cups frozen Southern-style hash brown potatoes, thawed
1 cup chopped green bell pepper, or to taste
1 (4 ounce) can chopped green chilies, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Cook and stir bacon and onion in a skillet over medium heat until bacon is crisp, 10 to 15 minutes. Drain grease, reserving drippings.
Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with reserved bacon grease.
Combine cooked bacon and onion, eggs, hash brown potatoes, Cheddar cheese, cottage cheese, Swiss cheese, bell pepper, and green chiles in the prepared baking dish; stir to combine.
Bake in the preheated oven until eggs are set firm, 35 to 40 minutes.
Let casserole cool 10 minutes before cutting to serve.

raw_recipe.headline: American Breakfast Casserole
raw_recipe.description: This all-American breakfast casserole is made with frozen hash brown potatoes, bacon, eggs, and a trio of cheeses. Perfect for breakfast and brunch!

review.reviewBody: Delicious.. I really liked the tang from the cottage cheese.. was different. I'll make this again

Loved it, but changed it a little bit. Used red and green peppers, swapped bacon for ham and omitted the cottage cheese and added 1/3 c cup half and half to eggs. Sauted meat and vegetables, than stirred in potatoes and cheese topped with egg and baked. All done in my trusty cast iron pan.

A great late night dinner. I used sausage as that is what I had. Green pepper,onion, 4 C hash browns,8 eggs, gruyere cheese 2 C,no cottage cheese,didn't have any ,S&P,onion powder,paprika,cayenne a big pinch,and baked in my cast iron pan. It only took 25 min to bake.let rest 10 min.
Great and enough left for breakfast the next morning

This was a delicious breakfast casserole! I pretty much went by the recipe except I used sausage in place of the bacon and also I normally don't have cottage cheese on hand, so I replaced it with a cream cheese/sour cream combo and will double this next time to make it creamier. I also added in a dash of garlic powder and parsley. It was super filling and made a great brunch! Half the recipe made plenty for us with leftovers. I made it all in my cast iron pan to eliminate an extra dish. So yummy and will definitely have to make it again. We garnished with sour cream and salsa. Thank you for the recipe!

This recipe was delicious and loved by my family. I will make again, especially for a crowd. I substituted browned turkey sausage for the bacon and sprayed the casserole dish with Pam instead of using bacon grease to save fat and calories. I found it took an extra 10 min in the oven till firm and done. Garnished with cilantro and salsa for extra zip and flavor.

I didn’t have any hash brown or cottage cheese so I diced 2 Yukon gold potatoes and sautéed those with the bacon, onions and peppers. I added a small pice of herbed goat cheese and shredded smoked Gouda instead of the Swiss cheese. It was excellent!

Very popular with our Christmas morning brunch bunch! We omitted the chilies, in deference to the tastes of some of our guests. I doubled the amount of egg - I started with 6 and it was evident that there was not enough to cover the other ingredients and bake sufficiently. As we already had purchased a large spiral-sliced ham, I substituted ham for bacon. Added red bell pepper to the green for effect.

I started a review but it posted before I finished. I made this for a group the day after Thanksgiving. The only thing I changed was to not use bacon grease but butter to prepare the pan. I also drained the bacon and veggies after cooking. The dish literally was completely clean within moments. People said it was the best breakfast casserole they’ve ever had. Next time I’ll add pickled jalapeños for a kick. We like spice. Try it!!

I changed a few things; 7 eggs instead of 6 because I used 2 cans green chilies; I used medium cheddar and 3 cheese blend (no Swiss); I used a roll of lean ground sausage cooked before added and 4 slices cooked bacon crumbled. Every adult that has tried it loved it but small kids just don't appreciate all of the different textures and colors so have something else available for them. It is wonderful!

I made this in a pressure cooker and it was good, just needed a bit more moisture. Used the saute function to cook the bacon and onion first, then added the rest of the ingredients. Will add 1/2 Cup milk next time. 15 minutes did the trick.

Awesome! I upsized by about a third and baked in disposable aluminum pan for a hungry crowd right before a winter morning snow shoeing expedition in the Rocky Mountains. I did need to bake longer to account for added volume. Everyone loved it! My 22 year old son is asking for recipe after taking leftovers home to share with room mate. This is definitely a keeper I’ll make again and again.
Quick easy and delicious
The combination of all the different cheeses left a strange taste.
I did not use the bacon grease on the pan. I used cooking spray instead. I also added grated parmesan

I prepared this recipe today for a breakfast meeting and it was a huge hit! All 9 ladies served (including me) loved it. 

As usual, I couldn't leave a recipe alone, though, and I tweaked it a bit. I used red bell pepper instead of green. The red peppers added more flavor and made the casserole look prettier. I added 1/2 lb breakfast sausage, browned first. I used 9 eggs instead of 6. Finally, I added some salt and pepper. It turned out absolutely scrumptious! 

By the way - I couldn't find Southern-style hash browns, so I used plain. That's part of the reason why I added seasonings to the recipe.

Placed pepperoni on top 
Used 2 cups cheddar only 
Used coloured pepper (1) & mushroom 
Added pepper & salt 

Top browned it 
Recipe is a keeper for quick brunches
Great breakfast casserole! Added can of Rotel (drained) which added great flavor!
This was so delicious, we were all so very impressed with it. I made it the night before and then popped it in the oven this morning. Best. Ever. Thank you!!!
I made this for dinner and substituted mild ground pork sausage for the bacon. It was so good. My husband took one bite and said "This is a keeper. Don't lose the recipe".
I made it exactly as the recipe said except I cut it in half because there are only three of us. It was delicious. I can't think of anything I would change.
